title_sq: Tek Liqeni i Thate, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 + Studio Me Verande Dhe Totalisht i Investuar!
description_sq: Tek Liqeni i Thate, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 + Studio me Verande dhe Totalisht i Investuar! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e pare banim (i 3te nga kuota hyrjes) dhe ne kat ndodhen vetem 2 apartamente dhe me orientim Jug-Lindje. Ka nje siperfaqe neto 102 m2 dhe veranda 26m2 qe ka nje pjese te mbyllur dhe eshte organizuar nga koridori shperndares, salloni ndenjes dhe gatimi, dhome gjumi matrimoniale me tualet, dhome gjumi femijesh, studio me pamje fantastike + lavanderi , garderobe dhe nje tualet. Investimet ne prone jane: tavan i varur, izolimi akustik i brendshem me apartamentin ngjitur, instalime hidraulike & elektrike mjaft cilesore, vetratat triplex, sistem kondicionimi multisplit "Mitsubishi", sistem CCTV & security. Apartamenti eshte i vendosur ne Kompleksin Residencial "Bora" i organizuar me 3 objekte, ndertuar vitet e fundit sipas standarteve me te larta te ndertimit, nen nje administrim dhe menaxhim shume te mire. Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor dhe mundesi blerje te nje post parkingu me cmim extra.
title_en: At Lake Dry, Apartment 2+1+2 + Studio With Veranda For Sale And Fully Invested!
description_en: At Lake Dry, Apartment 2+1+2 + Studio with Veranda and Fully Invested for Sale! The apartment is located on the first residential floor (3rd from the entrance quota) and there are only 2 apartments on the floor and with South-East orientation. It has a net area of ​​102 m2 and a 26m2 veranda that has a closed part and is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room and a kitchen, a matrimonial bedroom with a toilet, a children's bedroom, a studio with a fantastic view + a laundry room, a wardrobe and a toilet. Investments in the property are: suspended ceiling, internal acoustic insulation with the adjacent apartment, high-quality plumbing & electrical installations, triplex windows, "Mitsubishi" multisplit air conditioning system, CCTV & security system. The apartment is located in the Residential Complex "Bora" organized with 3 buildings, built in recent years according to the highest construction standards, under a very good administration and management. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation and the possibility of purchasing a parking post at an extra cost.
